title: M2.1 Combat-feel follow-up: pool the muzzle flash + impact spark (kill residual per-shot/per-hit allocation)
description: Follow-up from TASK-037 (reviewer MEDIUM). The projectile + trail are now pooled, but magic_manager._spawn_muzzle_flash still does muzzle_flash_scene.instantiate() per cast, and scripts/juice/impact_spark.gd queue_free()s a CPUParticles2D per hit. These are residual per-shot/per-hit allocations on the same hot path (and get worse with hold-to-fire from TASK-038). Route the muzzle flash and the impact spark through a pool (the existing scripts/combat/projectile_pool.gd ProjectilePool is generic and already supports a CanvasItem with no hooks). NOTE: test/test_muzzle_flash.gd asserts the flash is a DIRECT child of the passed parent — pooling nests it under a pool node, so this test's contract must be updated alongside (keep the visual identical; assert the flash still renders at the muzzle position). Tests-first: extend the pool tests to cover flash/spark acquire-release-no-leak; keep all visual tests green. Lower priority than the combo/HUD work; schedule after TASK-038/039/040 unless stutter persists.
acceptance_criteria: Muzzle flash and impact spark are pooled/reused (no per-shot/per-hit instantiate+free), reusing ProjectilePool or an equivalent; visuals identical.
test/test_muzzle_flash.gd updated so its parent/position contract matches the pooled structure while still asserting the flash renders at the muzzle; all visual tests green.
Pool acquire/release/no-leak tests cover the flash + spark; full GUT suite green exit 0 run multiple times; gdlint clean.
